title: Round HUD
note: One HUD for the whole round; s9 hides and returns the same nodes (Hud/Timer, Hud/Vitals/Health, Hud/Vitals/Stamina, Hud/Vitals/Mic, Hud/Slots). Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. The HUD never shows keys, walking or running, a player list, who knocked the player down, a destination or task progress. HUD edges sit 40 px in.

states.label: Порожні руки
states.note: Nothing carried; the crosshair is on a package within reach.

states.label: Несеш пакунок
states.note: Carrying a package with both hands: the hand slot widens; the package's room sign is on the 3D package only, the slot never repeats it.

states.label: Дисидент бачить напарника
states.note: A dissident with a knife on the belt sees a teammate's name plate with the teammate mark.

nodes.name: Plates
nodes.note: The name plate layer (#257), under the rest of the HUD: one Plate per other player in line of sight within about 10 m. Code: position = camera.unproject_position(head + 0.35 m), the plate centred on it; hidden behind walls (raycast), beyond 10 m or behind the camera. No role, no health.

children.name: Plate
children.note: One instance per visible player, moved every frame to the projected point (the sample sits over a teammate at about 538, 302).

children.name: Name
children.note: The player's name from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); no translated text.

children.name: Mark
children.note: Only on a dissident's client and only for a teammate. self_modulate = get_theme_color("font_color", "ToyNamePlateText").

children.name: Time
children.note: The round's time left as mm:ss from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), updated every second. The minimum width holds "00:00", so the plate never jitters.

children.name: Text
children.note: The player's own role for the round: role.engineer or role.dissident.

children.name: Cross
children.note: The crosshair dot, centred on the screen (its size is the variation's).

children.name: Aim
children.note: The name of the object under the crosshair within reach (item.package, item.knife, item.switch); hidden when nothing within reach is under the crosshair.

children.name: Health
children.note: Always shown in a round. No numbers: the bar's length is the real cue, the colour only adds to it.

children.name: Fill
children.note: value = hp (0 to 1). The fill colour follows the fraction: step = clampi(floori(hp * 20.0 + 0.5), 0, 20), Fill.self_modulate = get_theme_color("ramp_stop_%02d" % step, "ToyBarHealth").

children.name: Stamina
children.note: Always shown in a round; drains while sprinting and refills at rest.

children.name: Mic
children.note: Whether anyone hears the player. On: mic.svg tinted icon_on. Off (mic off, push-to-talk released, downed, pre and post game): mic-off.svg tinted icon_off (coral).

children.name: Slots
children.note: One slot pattern for both: empty shows the slot's name; a one-handed item shows only its icon (48 px); a two-handed item widens the hand slot and shows its icon and name.

children.name: Hand
children.note: Always the active slot. Two-handed carry (a package) uses the slot's wide width.

children.name: Icon
children.note: The hand slot's item icon (the package here). self_modulate = get_theme_color("font_color", "ToySlotText").

children.name: Name
children.note: Empty: hud.slot.hand in ToySlotTextEmpty. Two-handed item: the item's name in ToySlotText. One-handed item: hidden.

children.name: Icon
children.note: The belt slot's item icon: a one-handed item shows only its icon (the knife here). self_modulate = get_theme_color("font_color", "ToySlotText").

children.name: Name
children.note: Empty: hud.slot.belt. Hidden while the belt holds a one-handed item.
